payload.body:
The workflow 'Tests' failed on GitHub Actions and nothing else would have told you.

  repo:     dk-forge/ai-layoff-tracker
  workflow: Tests
  branch:   main
  trigger:  push
  run:      https://github.com/dk-forge/ai-layoff-tracker/actions/runs/31453717230

WHAT FAILED:
  AssertionError: No headline moves without rows to explain it: United States jobs, all time: OPEN INCIDENT, opened 0d ago (2026-08-10T19:36:59Z): +93,210 jobs over 3.0d on +18 entries (6,968,670 -> 7,061,880). The rows that changed carry at most 34,730 and the largest single row is 60,000, so NO ROW EXPLAINS THIS. Something re-scored rows that were already published: check the last reconcile-supers

Context from the failed step:
  FAIL: test_no_headline_moves_without_rows_to_explain_it (test_dedup_live.DedupLiveRegression.test_no_headline_moves_without_rows_to_explain_it)

What to do: open a Claude Code session in the ai-layoff-tracker repo and paste this line:
  "The GitHub Actions workflow 'Tests' is failing on main with: AssertionError: No headline moves without rows to explain it: United States jobs, all time: OPEN INCIDENT, opened 0d ago (2026-08-10T19:36:59Z): +93,210 jobs over 3.0d on +18 entries (6,968,670 -> 7,061,880). The rows that changed carry at most 34,730 and the largest single row is 60,000, so NO ROW EXPLAINS THIS. Something re-scored rows that were already published: check the last reconcile-supers. The run is https://github.com/dk-forge/ai-layoff-tracker/actions/runs/31453717230. Reproduce it locally, find the root cause, and fix it."

You will get ONE more email about this workflow: a RECOVERED notice on its next green run. We suppress repeats of this same failure on purpose. An alarm that mails eight times in an afternoon is one you learn to filter. A filtered alarm is how this defect stayed live for hours in the first place.
